upstream.name: sqlite/sqlite
upstream.architecture: SQLite database file format, b-tree pages, records, varints, journaling, SQL engine, extensions, and TCL/C regression harnesses.

benchmarkDenominator.source: Shallow blobless GitHub mirror clone at .upstream-cache/libsqlite; initially inspected as a root-only sparse checkout, then hydrated only the SQLite build/test directories needed for configure, testfixture, and Tcl runner execution: src, test, tool, ext, autosetup, autoconf, and mptest. The 2026-05-23 strengthened static denominator counts the hydrated Tcl/C/harness test inventory plus focused static Tcl command counts without hydrating unrelated blobless paths. Latest 2026-05-26 WAL refill reuses the static focused WAL inventory because this isolated worktree has no hydrated upstream cache. Native PHP now maps bounded WAL header/frame parsing, committed page-image extraction through the last commit frame, and malformed WAL rejection on top of accepted json_group_array(X ORDER BY Y), json_group_array(DISTINCT X), json_group_array/jsonb_group_array/json_group_object/jsonb_group_object aggregate state step/finalization, JSON remove, mutation, array-insert, aggregate dispatch, canonical, constructor, json_quote, json_valid, json_type/json_array_length, json_error_position, json_each/json_tree dispatch, hidden json/root columns, json_tree recursive rows, json_pretty, json_extract/jsonb_extract, JSON patch, and json_each evidence.
